title: AdaModalX: Synchronization-Free MFM Inference for Distributed Multimodal Mobile Sensing via Progressive Data Orchestration
abstract: arXiv:2611.20464v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal foundation models (MFMs) support generalizable inference in distributed mobile sensing applications by integrating heterogeneous data streams. However, existing MFM inference pipelines typically require complete and synchronized multimodal inputs, whereas mobile sensing streams arrive asynchronously due to network variability and heterogeneous data volumes across modalities. Waiting for all modalities increases end-to-end latency, while inference with incomplete inputs can reduce accuracy. We argue that multimodal inference should depend on the utility of available information rather than modality completeness. Based on this principle, we propose AdaModalX, a progressive multimodal inference framework that decouples inference execution from modality synchronization through runtime utility-aware orchestration. translated_title: AdaModalX：通过渐进式数据编排实现分布式多模态移动感知的无同步多模态基础模型推理
translated_abstract: 多模态基础模型（MFMs）通过整合异构数据流，支持分布式移动感知应用中的可泛化推理。然而，现有的MFM推理流水线通常需要完整且同步的多模态输入，而由于网络状况的波动以及各模态间数据量的异构性，移动感知数据流往往是异步到达的。等待所有模态到齐会增加端到端延迟，而使用不完整输入进行推理则会降低准确性。我们认为，多模态推理应当取决于可用信息的效用，而非模态的完整性。基于这一原则，我们提出了AdaModalX，这是一种渐进式多模态推理框架，通过运行时的效用感知编排，将推理执行与模态同步解耦。在每个设备上，重要性感知的数据上传利用从边缘侧MFM蒸馏得到的轻量级探针，从而实现可靠的（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出AdaModalX渐进式多模态推理框架，通过运行时效用感知的数据编排将推理执行与模态同步解耦，解决了分布式多模态移动感知中因数据异步到达导致的延迟与精度权衡问题。
en_tdlr: AdaModalX is a progressive multimodal inference framework that decouples inference execution from modality synchronization through runtime utility-aware data orchestration, addressing the latency-accuracy trade-off in distributed multimodal mobile sensing with asynchronous data streams.
